breadth.criterion: every mandatory atlas cell has primary authority coverage plus owner and verifier skills
breadth.observed: core atlas plus two adversarial extensions now cover 32 machine-validated cells; final novelty sweep remains open

depth.criterion: high-risk and high-drift domains use multiple independent primary sources where available
depth.observed: medical, accessibility, AI, security, platform, automotive, robotics, BCI, control-room, affective, avatar, and AAC authorities are represented; final cross-domain contradiction review remains open

contradictions.criterion: conflicting standards or guidance are resolved by scope/authority or preserved as explicit alternatives
contradictions.observed: WCAG 3 draft versus WCAG 2.2 normative status is separated; ISO drafts are distinguished from published standards; visual platform trends remain contextual rather than universal

novelty.criterion: a final adversarial search wave adds no material new decision mechanism or uncovered mandatory domain class
novelty.observed: recent sweeps discovered robotics, ambient intelligence, BCI, control-room HMI, affective UI, avatar representation, and AAC; another primary-source sweep is required before bounded saturation can be claimed

freshness.criterion: high-drift sources have reviewed_at plus radar cadence
freshness.observed: high-drift standards, platform, AI, and accessibility sources are dated and tracked by the research radar

reopen_conditions: new platform surface or input modality
new material specialist UI decision class
new empirical evidence invalidates a mechanism
mandatory atlas cell becomes unowned or unverifiable
